entities.summary:
Ikaalinen is a city and municipality of Finland. It is part of the Pirkanmaa region, located 55 kilometres (34 mi) northwest of Tampere. The town has a population of 6,711
(31 December 2025) and covers an area of 843.40 square kilometres (325.64 sq mi) of
which 93.16 km2 (35.97 sq mi)
is water.
